title: Kompass: Divided Germany: GDR, the Wall & the Peaceful Revolution
tip: Read the Kompass first: it gives you the key facts behind every question in this block.

exercises.title: Kompass: Divided Germany: GDR, the Wall & the Peaceful Revolution (1/2)
exercises.body: Two Germanys, 1949–1990. The **DDR**: SED one-party state, **Planwirtschaft**, the **Stasi** (Ministerium für Staatssicherheit) surveilling its own people, member of the **Warschauer Pakt**. Uprising **17. Juni 1953** crushed by Soviet tanks. **13.08.1961** the Wall closes West Berlin's escape hatch.

exercises.title: Kompass: Divided Germany: GDR, the Wall & the Peaceful Revolution (2/2)
exercises.body: West Germany's counter-story: **Ostpolitik** under Willy Brandt (Kniefall in Warsaw 1970, reconciliation through acknowledged guilt). **Herbst 1989**: Montagsdemos, "Wir sind das Volk," Wall opens **09.11.1989**, die **Wende**. **03.10.1990**: unification, five **neue Länder** join the Federal Republic. Woven into this block: two Jewish-history questions (Synagoge, Israel's founding) from the post-2024 update.

exercises.title: Kompass auf Deutsch: Geteiltes Deutschland: DDR, Mauer & Friedliche Revolution
exercises.body: 1949 DDR gegründet (sowjetische Zone). Einparteienstaat mit Planwirtschaft und Stasi. 17.6.1953 Volksaufstand. 1961 Mauerbau. Herbst 1989: friedliche Revolution, Montagsdemos, „Wir sind das Volk“ → 9.11.1989 Mauerfall.
